questions.answer: The trips with ESN are good value. Otherwise the busses are cheap and so is southern Italy.

Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Attend the ESN event at the start. Will be worth it long term.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Public transpiration being 100% unrealizable was annoying

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: All the expected great things about Italy (food, architecture, art etc.). Take advantages of the cheap and excellent coffee places as well.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Sort housing quickly
2. Don´t stress about uni, the exams were pretty low effort (and they want you to pass)
3. It is not cheap to live in Rome compared to the rest of Italy.
